variants.title: A · длинный овал
variants.prompt:
Create one original natural cinematic photograph of Zhanna, a fictional fourteen-year-old schoolgirl from the science-fiction novel ALIVE. She is short and slim, with FAIR LIGHT SKIN, LARGE NATURAL DARK BROWN EYES and SHORT BLACK HAIR. Her face should have natural teenage softness and normal believable proportions. Quietly attentive, thoughtful expression with a little warmth, relaxed mouth; an ordinary student rather than a fashion-model pose. She wears a simple loose muted dusty-teal cotton overshirt over a plain light-grey long-sleeve crew-neck shirt and dark charcoal trousers. Casual practical clothing, lightly worn, no logos or jewelry. Standing comfortably in a pale-grey spacecraft communal room on the Second Level, a worn sofa and potted plants softly blurred behind her, rounded interior doorway, soft white practical lighting. No exterior view. Horizontal 16:9 high-detail photograph. Medium portrait: the WHOLE head and hair with clear headroom, shoulders, torso, forearms and the top of trousers all visible, framed down to hips. Eye-level normal lens, natural face and fabric texture, restrained color, no retouching or makeup. No extra people, no text, no collage. One distinct fictional face, not a celebrity or another ALIVE character. Keep the same age, light skin, dark eyes, black short hair and outfit across the six casting options.
FACE VARIATION: An elongated softly oval face, fine straight brows, a narrow straight nose, small gently rounded chin and slightly prominent ears. Short straight black hair in an irregular ear-length crop with a broken fringe. Large dark eyes with a steady open gaze, pale neutral skin, subtle natural asymmetry.
